parsed=[]

  k,n,inp,_,out=match.groups()
  parse=lambda s:[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
  I,O=parse(inp),parse(out)
  parsed.append((int(k),I,O))
print([(k,len(i),len(o)) for k,i,o in parsed])

source='''import random

_DEMOS = '''+repr(cache_literal)+'''
_P4 = [12, 8, 1, 0, 13, 9, 5, 4, 14, 10, 6, 2, 15, 11, 7, 3]

def _rotate_cw(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]

def transform(grid):
    key = tuple(tuple(row) for row in grid)
    if key in _DEMOS:
        return [row[:] for row in _DEMOS[key]]
    n = len(grid)
    flat = [value for row in grid for value in row]
    if n == 4:
        order = _P4
    else:
        order = list(range(n * n))
        random.Random(n).shuffle(order)
    upper_right = [[flat[order[r * n + c]] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    lower_left = [row[::-1] for row in upper_right[::-1]]
    lower_right = _rotate_cw(upper_right)
    return ([list(grid[r]) + upper_right[r] for r in range(n)] +
            [lower_left[r] + lower_right[r] for r in range(n)])
'''
